{"draft": "A. O. Smith third-quarter sales climb as company prepares sale of majority stake in China business
A. O. Smith Corporation reported third quarter 2026 sales of $941 million, net earnings of $126 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.93.
North America segment sales climbed to $761.6 million, up 3%, helped by Leonard Valve acquisition sales, 13% boiler sales growth and pricing actions, partly offset by lower residential water heater volumes. The segment also recorded a $15 million sales contribution from Leonard Valve, and segment earnings reached $179.9 million with a segment margin of 23.6%.
Rest of World segment sales slipped to $192.8 million, down 7%, amid continued weakness in China's consumer appliance market. China sales fell 17% in local currency, while Rest of World segment earnings came to $10.5 million and segment margin was 5.4%.
The company announced definitive agreements under which CPE will acquire an 81% interest in its China business, while A. O. Smith retains a 19% stake and enters a long-term brand license agreement. The transaction values the China business at approximately $400 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, with total value expected to exceed $500 million including the net present value of licensing economics, and the structure will enable the company to repatriate approximately $80 million in cash held in China.
Year-to-date cash provided by operations was $429.4 million, while free cash flow came to $396.2 million. The company deployed $260.6 million to repurchase shares in the first nine months of 2026.
For full-year 2026, the company updated guidance to exclude the China business for all of 2026, projecting net sales growth, excluding China, of approximately 4% and adjusted EPS, excluding China, of between $3.42 and $3.52."}
